other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission file using a simple integer range instead of preserving the actual identifier column from the test dataset. This typically breaks automated scoring systems if the test set IDs are non-sequential.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Feature Alignment
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates missing value indicator columns dynamically based on whether missing values exist in each split, and then aligns the columns across train, validation, and test sets. This subtly leaks the presence of test-set missing values into the training feature space.

other_failure_modes.name: Using ID Column as a Feature
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the target column but does not check for or drop identifier columns (like 'id'). If an ID column is present and numerical, it will be treated as a regular feature and passed into the models, which can lead to overfitting.

summary: The agent provides a solid, well-structured solution with appropriate preprocessing, robust feature engineering, and a nicely tuned ensemble of tree-based and deep learning models. However, it fails to perform cross-validation for its stochastic models, and it overwrites the test set IDs with a hardcoded integer range, which will likely break submission scoring.
